rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a product warranty, especially one covering repairs during a stated period.

example.english: This phone has a one-year warranty, and it can be repaired for free if it breaks.
example.traditional: 部電話有一年保養，壞咗可以免費整。
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa6 jau5 jat1 nin4 bou2 joeng5 waai6 zo2 ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 zing2

rows.note: Use this for a legal or contractual warranty that guarantees the condition or quality of goods or property.

example.english: This sales contract provides a warranty that the property will have no structural problems at handover.
example.traditional: 呢份買賣合約保證間屋交樓時冇結構問題。
